title: Intentower verification report (T23, frozen for Phase 1)
description: One report per verification run. Every obligation carries a status; a result without a status is invalid. A report is evidence about a run, never an authorization: only `gate` (T25/T27) may conclude PASS, and it re-runs the POG and the solver instead of trusting this file.

schema_version.description: Frozen by T23. A report with any other value is not this schema.

model_id.description: Traceability id from the Intent -> Spec -> Model chain.

inputs.description: SHA256 of every input this run consumed: model sources and the POG artifacts read. T26 extends the chain, it does not redefine it.

kernel.description: Present only if a kernel-checked certificate was produced. Phase 1 has none.

build_ok.description: Rossi parsed, type-checked and generated the POG for these exact sources.

po_total.description: Count of ALL generated obligations, not a subset. The validator rejects po_total != len(obligations); zero obligations can never be PASS.

issues.description: Every non-success condition a reviewer must see: outside F0, tool errors, stale inputs, duplicate or missing obligations.

version.description: Exact version string as printed by the tool, e.g. `rossi 0.2.3`.

id.description: Component-qualified obligation id exactly as the POG names it, e.g. `m1::add/grd2/GRD`.

detail.description: Why a status is not SMT_DISCHARGED: the rejected node, the solver error, and so on.

code.description: Machine-readable reason, e.g. OUTSIDE_F0, TOOL_ERROR, STALE_INPUT, DUPLICATE_PO, ZERO_PO, MISSING_PO.

eventb_model_smt_checked.description: True only if SMT was actually run over the Event-B obligations. Checked is not proved.

implementation_formally_verified.description: No Rust/Python code is verified by this pipeline; a model proof never says otherwise.
